title: Local-MMLU question
description: One multiple-choice question. One JSON object per line in data/{lang}/{subject}/{split}.jsonl.

id.description: Globally unique. Format: {lang}-{subject}-{5 digit sequence}, e.g. ja-civil_law-00123

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag. Must match the data/{lang} directory.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the jurisdiction the exam belongs to (TW, JP, KR, US, GB, NL, DE, IT, ...).

subject.description: snake_case subject key. Must match the data/{lang}/{subject} directory and a row in subjects/{lang}.tsv.

category.description: Top-level grouping, same four groups TMMLU+/MMLU use.

choices.description: Variable length. Rendered as A, B, C, ... by the evaluator.

explanation.description: Optional rationale. Never shown to the model at test time.

source.description: Human-readable exam name and session, e.g. '司法試験 2022 短答式'.

license.description: SPDX-style identifier. Must appear in schema/licenses.json.

contributed_by.description: GitHub handle or pseudonym of the contributor.

reviewed_by.description: Reviewers who approved the item. Strict mode requires >= 2 for the test split.
